title: Zipper
prompt: a large zipper sewn into two fabric strips on a table with three buttons: “Close” draws the slider upward and meshes the teeth; “Open” pulls it downward and separates the teeth; “Tug” pulls the closed strips sideways without opening them; see-through reveals the slider's separating wedge and converging channels
blurb: An enlarged sewn zipper shows how a slider joins nested teeth and how the closed chain resists a staged sideways tug.
representativeMechanism: Closed-end metal scoop zipper with a non-locking Y-channel slider.

sources.title: The Way Things Work Now, 2016, printed page 17
sources.supports: Separator wedge opens; converging slider sides close.

sources.title: YKK, zipper structure
sources.supports: Tape, elements and slider; Y-shaped passage joins and separates elements.

sources.title: Gideon Sundback, US1219881A
sources.supports: Corded tapes, clamped jaws, staggered cup teeth with projections and recesses, slider channels and stops.

truthNotes: Educational adaptation, not a reproduction of the book illustration or a dimensioned YKK product.
The table is a teaching support. External hands are represented by red force arrows, excluded from anatomy.
Close and Open animate slider travel. Tug closes first when needed and then stretches the cloth under a modest staged pull; it is not a load rating or an assertion that zippers cannot fail.
The metal cup surfaces are simplified; the model retains a physical recess, projection and alternating rows.
See-through fades slider wings to expose its diamond and converging flange channels.
The slider is non-locking. No hidden automatic lock, gears or motors are implied.

verification.telemetry: n/a; standalone static figure has no production telemetry
verification.viewsInspected: All seven in normal and see-through modes, including native 2x crops; 4x mechanism close-up inspected.
verification.videoReview: Sampled frames every 3 seconds reviewed in evidence/video-contact.png; initial state, opening, closing, tug, see-through, rear view and phone states visible.
verification.harnessCorrection: An initial repair check read animation state after a screenshot and failed after the animation ended. The corrected test captures state at the condition boundary; failure retained in evidence/round1-failed.
limitations: Independent other-family verification remains for the coordinator to assign.
Live verification untested; no production telemetry is installed in this standalone static figure. Dashboard not applicable.
Minor cosmetics retained: segmented cloth outlines and crossed label leaders. On the 390px phone view badge 15 overlaps zoom, while its BOTTOM STOP legend entry remains readable and buttons work.
Educational geometry and staged textile strain are not a dimensioned product model, physical collision simulation, or load rating.
1988 inaccessible/unverified; 1998 not independently verified; no verified three-edition union.
